answer: The oasis holds 250 bounties funded by outside buyers, who cannot claim a bounty they paid for, so a farm cannot invent its own demand. Each bounty arrives as a comet: a brief published at a random second and hash-locked until then, so it cannot be drafted early. A claim binds one key to one solution, and the reef, a public log of solution hashes, drops any repeat hash. Each comet is a different brief with one winner, so copies fail and unused keys earn nothing. Attacker pays: 1,000 fakes earn only by writing distinct solutions; taking all 250 bounties costs about $8 each, $2,000 this epoch.
